import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final long DOUBLE_MOD = MOD;
    
    static long mod_pow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long p = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        long k = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        
        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(mod_pow(p, p - 1));
            return;
        }
        
        if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(mod_pow(p, p));
            return;
        }
        
        long order = 1;
        long cur = k % p;
        while (cur != 1) {
            cur = (cur * k) % p;
            ++order;
        }
        
        System.out.println(mod_pow(p, (p - 1) / order));
    }
}
